## Outcome

What can the user do when this is complete?

## Requirements and scope

Requirement IDs, phase, included work, exclusions, dependencies, and owned files.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Concrete observable behavior.
- [ ] Meaningful automated tests and relevant device checks.
- [ ] Complete manual-test instructions supplied when needed, with actual results recorded; otherwise explain why manual testing is not required.
- [ ] Documentation, function comments, and learning explanation updated.
- [ ] Small commits with titles and complete descriptions.
- [ ] Entire remaining plan and outstanding dependencies reviewed; adjustments or "No adjustments needed" recorded in the completion note.

## Validation and learning

Commands/demo, failure cases, and the Kotlin/Android concept this task teaches.

## Manual-test instructions

If unnecessary, state "Not required" and explain why. Otherwise fill in a complete procedure; do not leave these prompts as the final instructions.

- Purpose/acceptance criterion:
- Prerequisites: device/emulator, build/commit and installation steps, permissions/voice/account/accessories, network and initial app state.
- Exact test data: fixture or full routine/settings, starting screen and playback state.
- Numbered actions: give each action and its expected visible/audible result, including exact waits where relevant.
- Variants and pass/fail criteria: include agreed timing tolerance and measurement method if relevant.
- Evidence/results: how to capture requested redacted evidence; record device/build, expected/actual result and pass/fail/blocked/not run for each case.
- Cleanup/recovery: stop sessions, restore changed settings, remove test content; explain data impact and preservation for any destructive setup.
